verdicts.reason: A and B look pixel-identical, and both have the same faults. The photo only covers the left ~40% and stops short of the bottom, leaving a white strip under it. The right half of the canvas is plain white dead space. The white cross shape, the original's main graphic device, now sits on a white background, so it shows only as a faint outline and its brand shape is lost. The headline is jammed against the photo's edge and floats with no anchor. The ilovesilklinen.com URL is tiny and pushed to the bottom edge. The layout reads as a shrunken original pasted onto a wide canvas, not a banner rearranged for the new shape.
